title: ASTM F3049-14(2021) Standard Guide for Characterizing Properties of Metal Powders Used for Additive Manufacturing Processes
notes: Public ASTM store product page read on 2026-10-15. Active guide; the page lists F3049-14(2021) as current and F3049-14 as the earlier version. Committee F42, subcommittee F42.05. Scope as stated on the public page: introduces characterisation techniques for metal powders used in powder-based additive manufacturing, including powder bed fusion, and points to existing standards for virgin and used powders. Purchase required. It is a guide, not an acceptance specification: the powder limits themselves come from the governing material specification and the purchase contract. The ASTM page states that use of AI on ASTM standards is prohibited, so only designation, title and scope are cited.
